businesses.business: Payroll and HR software and services

offering_description.value: Asure sells payroll, HR, benefits, and compliance tools to employers. Customers can run these functions on its platform or have Asure specialists manage them. The platform also offers payroll-related financial services and a partner marketplace.

quotes.quote: Run payroll and HR yourself—or have Asure’s experts manage it for you. One platform for payroll, HR, benefits, and compliance.

Jay Whitehead leads Asure’s AsurePay and marketplace initiatives, expanding financial services and partner-driven capabilities on the platform. He brings experience in payments, partnerships, and product commercialization, with a focus on creating flexible solutions that enhance payroll without adding complexity.

quotes.quote: Use the AsureCentral platform to process payroll, manage employee records, track time, administer benefits, and give employees self-service access to their information.

quotes.quote: AsureCentral powers payroll, HR, benefits, and workforce management for employers. Whether you run payroll internally or rely on AsureWorks to manage the work for you, everything operates through one connected system designed for businesses managing employees.

In addition to financial leadership and public company governance, he is responsible for the financial infrastructure that underpins payroll funding, tax payments, and compliant client money movement at scale.
